# E8 QUARANTINE: every fit, threshold and selection in this file is made on E3-E7 only; E8 rows are ONE labeled blind read and were never an input to any choice.

# DISTILLATION with a LAWFUL teacher: unconstrained capacity (depth 12, 300 rounds, no subsampling) fitted on the TRAINING WINDOW ONLY, never on the evaluation era.  This is NOT the sufficiency memorizer, which was fitted on the evaluation rows to measure a representation ceiling.

# The teacher's within-cell score percentile becomes the student's relevance on the SAME 0..4 ladder.  SOFT = teacher only; MIX = 50/50 teacher and true grades; SOFT_VM = teacher targets with volmatch weighting.
# The teacher memorises the TRAINING era's noise -- that is the known danger, and the 5-seed walk-forward evaluation is the instrument that catches it.
